title: Anointing Oil
summary: Anointing with oil could mark consecration, honor, healing, burial preparation, hospitality, or symbolic appointment.
background: The meaning depends on context. Kings, priests, sacred objects, guests, the sick, and the dead may all be associated with oil in different ways.
teachingHelp: Before applying anointing imagery, ask what kind of anointing the passage describes: consecration, hospitality, healing, burial, or honor.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
